title: = I39b: I39's laws over I85's product machine (O7 PAR-cycle, the O8 law pair under HypC with a hypothesis split, O24, the F11 L1-count law), plan-stated in a frozen sidecar and generated by holon/derivation/laws.py as I65's contract laws are (no rule of the catalog discovers a product obligation, so no catalog bump), in their own law set laws/M3/derivation/; every law decided UNKNOWN for lack of a Bend model of the consumer (AGENTS rules 5 and 6), each record carrying the evaluator-level witness of a bounded search on I85's product machine and its replay on the real consumer; results/M3/derivation/splits.json in I12's holon-splits/0.1 shape; I89 builds the consumer's Bend model and re-decides the frozen statements

predictions.claim: The five plan-stated laws are generated and registered (L1-L5): laws/M3/derivation/ holds exactly the laws of thresholds.law_ids and REGISTRY.json; each law file is tests_m3/_i88.py::expected_law byte for byte (the sidecar's statement with the product and hypothesis refs inserted, rule_catalog_version holon-rules/0.1, facts the adopted Rollup document) and is valid against spec/schemas/law_ir_0_3.schema.json with its additive product term; REGISTRY.json lists each law's holon.gen.refs.law_hash; `holon derivation laws --check` reproduces. Derivation: the generator copies the frozen statements and inserts the refs; a 0.3 hash's refs treat a term they do not know as structure, so law_hash takes the product terms (disclosed: law_hash was run on the instrument's expected laws at the prereg; the generator, the registry and the schema term are not built).

Every law of the set is UNKNOWN (D1-D2): no Bend model of the consumer exists in I88, so by AGENTS rules 5 and 6 none is PROVED or REFUTED whatever its evaluator witness; each record is a valid holon-record/0.2 record whose first attempt is Bend's, not run for lack of a Bend model of the consumer, and whose second is the product evaluator's, with the law's hypothesis names as model_assumptions. Derivation: I88's scope as the coordinator ruled it (the consumer's Bend model is I89's); no statement is weakened, and I89 decides the same frozen statements.

The evaluator-level search (W1-W4) finds, within its bound, the witnesses of thresholds.predicted: L_prod_cycle_lastBlockNumber (O7) at product/01 commit 1 with n 2 and mutation last_number, the derived lastBlockNumber 3 against the committed LastBlockNumber 2; L_prod_count_l1MsgNum (F11's L1 count) at product/01 commit 1, n 1, l1_count, the derived sum of l1MsgNum 1 against the committed L1MessagePopped 0; L_prod_trailing_HypC_ignores_trailing (O8 under the ignores hypothesis, its circuit accepting every step) at product/01 commit 1, n 1, trailing, trailing 1 against 0; L_prod_calldata_BlockContexts (O24) at product/02 commit 1 (the first version-0 commit), n 1, the calldata pair, derived blocks [1] against [2]; and no witness for L_prod_trailing_HypC_binds_trailing in the whole bound, its premises holding at least once. Derivation: reading ParseBatch at the head: after the version-0-parent start-block check it never compares the last decoded context's number with LastBlockNumber (with n 2 a last context numbered L + 1 passes; with n 1 the shifted first context fails that check, so the n 1 candidate is no witness); it never reads NumL1Messages and checks only txsNum >= l1MsgNum per block; it never checks that the transaction queue is empty when the blocks are done; and a version-0 batch with calldata contexts takes its block count and contexts from them, which neither the commit's input nor its header holds. I85's product commits carry numL1Messages 0, and the genesis parent is version 0, so the first step's start is 1. The least certain prediction: an unsupported model step, the compressor or decompressor on these payloads, or a check misread misses it.

Every evaluator witness replays on the real consumer (RP1-RP2): the real ParseBatch at the pinned commit, run on each witness's batch with its real blobs and calldata contexts, returns ok and gives the model's observation (status passed for the four witnesses of P3). Derivation: I85's refinement (169 cases, 0 disagreements) covers the paths these witnesses take (the version-0-parent start-block path, the version-0 calldata path and the dequeue loop) with the same consumer code; the witnesses differ from its cases only in payload contents.

The hypothesis split report (SP1): results/M3/derivation/splits.json holds exactly one pair, family HypC, the two O8 laws with their hypotheses, both UNKNOWN, split false (thresholds.predicted_splits). Derivation: P2, and the pair's statements are equal but for the hypothesis's name (S1). BUILD_PLAN I39's split (binds PROVED, ignores REFUTED) needs I89's Bend model.

Every witness's commit is ok on the adopted Rollup document (W2): each witness's commit step succeeds from its product state, and its committed header's LastBlockNumber (versions 1 and 2) and L1MessagePopped are the members the commit took (lastBlockNumber start + n - 1, numL1Messages 0). Derivation: a candidate keeps its product plan's members except lastBlockNumber, which the commit stores and hashes without a check; I85's P4 committed every product plan.

regressions.claim: Nothing rule-derived moves: I85's `holon derivation product --check` and `refine --check` reproduce with I88's code present, and laws/M3's top level holds exactly the laws DERIVATION.json lists (the law set is a subdirectory).

I88's own commits (the contract's definition) change only what the contract allows: no frozen root, laws/ outside laws/M3/derivation/, spec/ other than spec/schemas/law_ir_0_3.schema.json, holon/rules/, holon/frontends/, a file of thresholds.closures, replay/ other than replay/M3/derivation/laws.json, gen/ outside gen/M3/derivation/laws/, or results/ outside results/M3/derivation/laws/ and results/M3/derivation/splits.json. So no record is re-made.

holon audit prereg passes for M2 and M3 (tested). On CI, on the build head: gate-M0, gate-M1 and gate-M2 pass; gate-M3-partial and gate-M3-G2 fail only on the base's items (thresholds.base_gate_M3); tests-m3-catalog, the frozen suite, freeze-check and both audits pass. The full M3 gate is not claimed.

The modules I88 adds under holon/derivation/ are generic: no token of thresholds.forbidden anywhere in the file, no target identifier of tests_m2/test_target_agnostic_exhaustive in code, no address, no test import; and no file of holon/derivation/ is in a generator closure.
